introHtml: Wheat straw is a rapidly renewable, agricultural byproduct that gives gift sets a natural, eco-friendly edge over plastic or traditional materials. These bundles are ideal for companies with sustainability goals, trade show giveaways, or employee recognition programs. The material has a warm, textured finish that accepts screen printing or debossing well, letting your logo stand out while reinforcing your environmental commitment. Each set combines practical items like notebooks, drinkware, or utensils in a unified, earth-conscious package.
